note: Per-pixel surface Y offsets. Index = x-in-cell (0..15), value = Y where the player's feet rest within the 16px cell (0=top, 15=bottom, 16=no contact). Shape 0 is all-air (used as sentinel). Shape 1 is a 45 up-ramp walking right: feet rise from Y=15 at x=0 to Y=0 at x=15. Shape 2 mirrors it (up-ramp walking left). HFlip/VFlip on each SlopeCell give the other 2 variants.
